title: Raster Framework Integration
description: Integrate raster technology with framework mechanisms for selection, hover, document, details, and catalogue — align with draw/play patterns.
summary: Aligned raster play with framework integration patterns (matching draw/play): added tree-row↔layer-id mapping helpers in raster/core; selectionChange on document and masks trees with setSelection resolving tree row ids; refactored inspector to uiInspectorGroupsToTree with readonly id/kind fields; catalogue panel uses CANVAS_HOVER_SOURCE_CATALOG; RasterPlayPaneSurfaceHost wires onCommit→commitDocument. All raster core/play/react tests pass (10+8+2).
